_note: Meanings marked verified=false are INFERRED from the sample maps. Edit this file to correct them; the recognizer reads it at run time.

references.note: Common CATV symbol NAMES (amp, splitters, taps by output count 1/2/4/6/8, cable 0.412/0.500/0.750/1.000, power supply, standby, EQ/attenuator). Shapes are graphics only; no abbreviations like CSC/NT/SA.
SCTE graphic symbols (15 pages) is image-only, text not extractable; ANSI/SCTE 87 full standard is behind SCTE login.

confirmed_map_key.notes: numbers inside taps and couplers are dB values, not port counts
confirmed_map_key.half_black_half_white_circle: directional coupler (number = coupling dB; black half = tap leg, white half = through leg)
confirmed_map_key.node_legs: A upper-left, B upper-right, C lower-left, D lower-right (aliases only; hardware ports unconfirmed)
confirmed_map_key.station_ids: A# station (A2 = node in coax map), E# endpoint; not tap values or cable types
confirmed_map_key.cable: printed .412 treated as MC2 .500 (user assumption); walkout used for cable types/footage only
